Wasted.reason: Unconditional instant creature removal for three mana.

Food Coma.reason: Broad creature removal with a Food resource.

Brie-lliant Trapper.reason: Efficient body, Food production and repeatable removal.

Gimme the herbs.reason: Narrow Forest selection; needs enough Forests.

Hallucinating Trip.reason: Narrow Forest payoff that risks the mana base.

Overdose.reason: Graveyard setup and self-loss risk; not an unconditional bomb.

Wedding Ring.reason: Requires multiple creatures and additional single-target spells.

The Fallen.reason: Requires discard support rather than immediate standalone value.

Last Man Standing.reason: Powerful but random sweeper; not reliable spot removal.

Numbing Mass Resurrection.reason: Symmetric graveyard payoff with six-mana/setup requirements.
